latest_release.name: v1.5.0
latest_release.body:
## Final Release (v1.5.0)

** this project wil be archived soon **

when i started this project 9 months ago, it was really just a side project to help indie devs make better demos and share what they were building. i never expected it to get anywhere close to where it is today. somehow it ended up at 120k+ downloads and almost 40k stars, which is still kind of crazy to me.

i've genuinely enjoyed building it, but i also feel like i've achieved everything i originally set out to do with the project. i guess that's also part of why i'm comfortable ending it.

there are already plenty of successors and forks carrying the torch in their own way and I highly encourage you to check [them](https://github.com/webadderallorg/Recordly) out. 

thanks to **everyone** who contributed 🙏 , used the app and helped maintain the project, making it truly community first.

even though i'm stepping away, i'd still love to see what people continue building with OpenScreen. if you're using it for your demos, products, walkthroughs, feel free to tag me on X and share what you've made. seeing how people used OpenScreen was always one of the most rewarding parts of working on it.

### Changes

- Native Capture in MacOS & Windows (sorry Linux folks 😢)
- Much improved camera animation (Auto-focus cursor tracking) - [check video here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_fJvf_V9W226ivo4BeQQGTe1-932AMRf/view?usp=sharing); manual is still an option 
- Custom Cursors (size, type, effects, post recording path smoothening)
- Auto Captioning for voiceovers.
- New and improved UI.
- Improved stability for longer recordings. 
- Disable webcam post processing. 
- Timeline Snapping guides.
- Annotation text animations.
- Language support: English, Arabic, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)
- Audio waveform for easier hinting.
- deprecated Blurs. 
- Vertical HUD layout (toggle)

> [!Note] > OpenScreen is now archived and no longer maintained. if you are looking for something similar, checkout : https://github.com/getopenscreen/openscreen maintained by some folks, nice enough to continue this project in their own way. >



#

OpenScreen

OpenScreen is your free, open-source alternative to Screen Studio.

If you don't want to pay $29/month for Screen Studio but want a version that does what most people seem to need - quick, polished product demos and walkthroughs you'd post on X, Reddit or Youtube. OpenScreen does not offer every Screen Studio feature, but covers a lot of the core functionality. Screen Studio is an awesome product and this is definitely not a 1:1 clone. If you just want something fully free and open source, this project should cover most of your needs. **100% free** for both **personal** and **commercial** use. Use it, modify it, distribute it. Please respect the License. > [!NOTE] >Software should be accessible. OpenScreen has no paid tiers, premium features, upsells, or functionality locked behind a paywall. > [!WARNING] > This started as a side project that blew up; not production grade and you'll hit bugs, but hopefully it covers what you need.

## Core Features - Record a specific window, or your whole screen. - Record microphone and system audio. - Webcam overlay with picture-in-picture, drag-to-position, mirroring, and shape options. - Auto or manual zooms with adjustable depth, duration, easing, and pixel-precise position; auto-zoom follows your cursor as you work. - Custom cursor size, smoothing, and click effects, with cursor themes and post-recording path smoothing. - Automatic captions for voiceovers, generated on-device with no upload (works offline). - Wallpapers, solid colors, gradients, or your own background image. - Motion blur. - Crop, trim, and per-segment speed control on the timeline. - Text, arrow, and image annotations, with text animation presets. - Timeline snapping guides and an audio waveform to make trimming easier. - Customizable keyboard shortcuts. - Export to MP4 or GIF in multiple aspect ratios and resolutions. - Languages supported: Arabic, E
